newsitem.title: USA: Diamond Lane names first chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Diamond Lane names first chief executive.

text.p: Diamond Lane Communications Corp on Wednesday its board of directors named Jerry Parrick to the new position of chief executive officer.
Diamond Lane, formed in June 1995 to produce a digital subscriber line system to quicken data communications through the Internet, said Parrick would take up the post on April 1.
Parrick previously was president of the Interprise data-networking business at U S West Communications Group, the regional telephone company.
Diamond Lane is preparing for the commercial launch this summer of its first product, an xDSL/ATM (digital subscriber line/asynchronous transfer mode) data access system.
